snippet.title: SKULD - Official Kickstarter Trailer
snippet.description:
SKULD - A Norse Mythology Action Tower Defense

In this third-person tower defense with deckbuilding, stop waves of enemies by combining turret management and melee combat.

🟢 KICKSTARTER LIVE NOW: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1412346420/skuld-a-norse-mythology-action-tower-defense
